天亮时说书人宣布现在是第几天: At dawn, the Storyteller announces which day it is
心理博弈（Rochambeau，作者 Habby）：很多能力要「赌」——赌徒猜角: Rochambeau (by Habby): many abilities are gambles — the Gambler guesses characters, the Acrobat bets on who's sober, the Lycanthrope bets on who's good, the Gossip bets on their own statement.
半兽人杀了好人，当晚恶魔就不杀人：今晚是谁动的手，本身就是线索。帽匠死了，邪恶可: When the Lycanthrope kills a good player, the Demon doesn't kill that night: who did tonight's killing is a clue in itself. When the Hatter dies, evil can swap to a whole new set of characters.
赏金猎人会把一名镇民变成邪恶：邪恶多一个人，这个人不知道队友是谁。: The Bounty Hunter turns a Townsfolk evil: evil gets one more player, who doesn't know their teammates.
